claims.title: Label claims
claims.subtitle: CIB&RC label claims: SKU × crop × pest × dose × PHI. Only approved claims can back a recommendation.
claims.editorHelp: Enter the claim exactly as printed on the registered label.
claims.editApprovedHelp: Approved claims cannot change. Saving creates a new draft version; the current one stays in force until the new version is approved.

fields.dosePerAcreHelp: As printed on the label, e.g. 40-50 ml
fields.sourceRefHelp: CIB&RC registration number or label reference

claims.approveRegulatory: Approval is a regulatory decision. It is recorded under your name ({name}) with the date and time, and the SKU becomes recommendable for this crop and pest immediately.
claims.retireHelp: The SKU stops being recommended for this crop and pest immediately. Retired claims cannot be edited.
claims.emptyHelp: Add the claims from the registered labels so SKUs can be recommended.

preview.title: Preview recommendation
preview.help: What the app may recommend: only SKUs with an approved claim for exactly this crop and pest.
preview.pick: Choose a crop and a pest or disease.
preview.none: No SKU has an approved label claim for this crop and pest.
preview.dose: Dose {dose} per acre · {tank} per 15 L tank
